title: Unredacted RESEND_API_KEY printed in chat transcript
root_cause: First grep command on Mac Mini .env had no redaction filter; the sed redaction was only applied to the second output line, so the raw .env line (full key) was echoed to the conversation transcript before the redacted version.
what_i_did_wrong: Sent a raw grep of a secret-bearing .env line to stdout in chat, violating the standing rule 'never read .env contents in chat; grep OK but redact keys'.
impact: Full Resend API key (re_FWTW...) visible in this session transcript. Key is a low-privilege sending-only key; transcript access is local/controlled. No external exposure identified.
corrective_action: All subsequent secret greps must redact in the same pipeline (sed/regex before stdout). Key pipe Mac->VPS done without echoing. Rotation optional if user desires; key is actively needed for sign-in.
